notice: Source review is informational, not legal advice. Verify the exact work, version, item-level license, attribution, third-party material, and applicable terms before acquisition or training.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.license_summary: Rights are work- and jurisdiction-specific; Project Gutenberg's own license and title record must be inspected for each item.
sources.acquisition_constraints: The main site says it is intended for human use and automated bulk access may be blocked. For many books use its offline catalog and approved mirrors, follow robot/download terms, and do not assume US public-domain status applies elsewhere.

sources.name: Wikimedia text dumps
sources.license_summary: User text is generally CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL under the terms; imported text can have additional source licenses and attribution notices. Non-text media has varied licenses.
sources.acquisition_constraints: Keep page/revision identity and attribution; exclude GFDL-only, fair-use, incompatible, and third-party material unless separately reviewed. Respect dump/API policies.

sources.name: Stack Exchange Data Dump
sources.license_summary: Public user contributions have date-dependent CC BY-SA terms: 2.5 before 2011-04-08 UTC, 3.0 until 2018-05-02 UTC, and 4.0 thereafter. Revisions may have distinct details.
sources.acquisition_constraints: Record post/revision identifiers, dates, authorship attribution, license version, and dump version; exclude deleted, non-public, or otherwise uncleared content. Review share-alike obligations before use.

sources.name: OpenStax College Algebra 2e
sources.license_summary: The inspected title page declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and describes third-party art attribution conditions.
sources.acquisition_constraints: Excluded by the default release policy because NonCommercial is not allowlisted. Other OpenStax books may have different terms; verify each title and embedded item.

sources.name: Python 3 documentation
sources.license_summary: Documentation is PSF-2.0; examples, recipes, and code from Python 3.8.6 onward are additionally dual-licensed under 0BSD. The license page lists incorporated third-party components.
sources.acquisition_constraints: Record documentation version and page URL. Review embedded third-party material and examples separately; do not treat all bundled snippets as PSF-2.0 only.
